title: Drag x Drive
subtitle: Two mouse controls drive two wheels
summary: Drag x Drive is Nintendo's three-on-three sports game, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 14 August 2025.
body: Drag x Drive is Nintendo's three-on-three sports game, released for Nintendo Switch 2 on 14 August 2025. Players control robotic competitors in wheelchair-like vehicles and attempt to score in the opposing basket. Its distinctive control scheme uses both Joy-Con 2 controllers as mice, assigning one to each wheel. Movement therefore comes from the coordination of the player's hands: sliding both forward drives ahead, while moving one differently turns the vehicle towards another route through the court.

Shooting changes the gesture from propulsion to a raised hand and flick of the wrist. A player must first create a useful position, then shift from driving to aiming before a defender closes the space. Raising an arm also signals for a pass, and opponents can challenge possession or block a shot. The controls make basic teamwork physical. Reaching open ground, asking for the ball and attempting a basket each require a different movement rather than a separate abstract command alone.

Half-pipes surround the court, letting competitors launch into tricks and dunks above the ordinary playing surface. Practice against computer-controlled opponents provides time to learn the relationship between wheel movement and positioning before online matches. Sayako Doi composed the music. Drag x Drive uses a compact sport to demonstrate the Switch 2's dual mouse input, building the contest around the effort of steering, turning and shooting with the same two hands that give the player's vehicle its momentum.
